title: The total of 100 dice is nearly normal
caption: The total has mean 350 and SD 17.08. With the continuity correction, P(total > 370) = P(total ≥ 371) ≈ P(Z > 1.2) ≈ 0.115.
alt: A normal curve with mean 350 and standard deviation 17.08, shaded to the right of 370.5, area about 0.115.
description: Each roll has mean 3.5 and variance 35/12, so 100 rolls total 350 with variance 291.7.
The central limit theorem makes the total approximately normal.
Shade the tail above 370.5 (continuity correction): z ≈ 1.20, area ≈ 0.115.
